reason: The parent contract named DETERMINISTIC_SPATIAL_BALANCE but did not define a scalable algorithm. The first CIR04 attempts stopped before structural scoring because of dependency and historical-evidence contract failures. This amendment fixes comparator identity before any structural-family outcome is scored.

comparator.candidate_pool: exact same frozen candidate frame as structural and nearest-known methods
order: sort candidates by Morton code of normalized grid indices with stable candidate hash tie-break
visit both ends of the Morton curve then recursively visit interval midpoints until every candidate appears once
comparator.complexity: O(n log n) time / O(n) memory

scope: three-family public structural smoke only; it does not replace maximin in the already executed 96-pair environment-vs-distance comparison or any other predeclared experiment
forbidden: do not switch between maximin and Morton based on observed recovery
do not call Morton ordering GRTS
do not use structural support, occurrence distance, habitat values or held-out outcomes to alter Morton order
do not retroactively reinterpret the 96-pair maximin results
